targets.T5: weekly next-week log Binance quote volume

screen_gate: pooled loss difference 95% circular block-bootstrap interval entirely below 0 AND lower loss in >= 4 of 6 test years (2019-2024)
selection: at most 3 passing configurations by interval upper end; ties prefer S3/S4; selection.json committed before any holdout read
holdout_gate: refit on all development samples; one-sided bootstrap p of loss difference; Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
no_tuning: no feature, model or threshold change after any holdout read

changes: selection ranks passing configurations by interval upper bound divided by the comparator loss (scale-free), ties prefer S3/S4
linear models search the alpha grid only when the training window holds >= 2 x inner_len rows; otherwise fallback alpha 10 (registered); chosen alpha recorded per fold
screen refuses to overwrite an existing selection.json; holdout writes a one-shot lock with the selection commit and blob before any sealed read
report adds Brier scores, per-year absolute losses, missing-target counts and the multiplicity disclosure
